summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in AI safety, watermarking, and enterprise adoption. Anthropic's Claude introduces new watermarks, while OpenAI launches Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6. Google and Meta make strides in AI-powered health coaching and open-source models.
insight: The increasing focus on AI safety and watermarking suggests a growing concern about the potential misuse of AI-generated content, highlighting the need for more robust regulations and standards in the industry.
highlights: Anthropic's Claude introduces new watermarks to prevent misuse
OpenAI launches Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6, targeting enterprise users
Google and Meta advance AI-powered health coaching with new partnerships
